WITH item AS (
  SELECT oi.order_item_id AS oiid, c.town_city AS town,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town AS (
  SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM item
  GROUP BY town
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM town
)
SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_excess
FROM town t, overall o
WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio
